verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents "remote view and control" as a core feature, and a heavy daily user reports keyboard handling without the AnyDesk NumLock bug. That same user reports alt-tab problems from Linux to Windows, and nothing in the evidence specifically covers native mouse, scroll or keyboard event injection on the host. missing for 10: explicit documentation of mouse/keyboard/scroll injection as native host events, scroll-specific evidence, reliable special-key handling (alt-tab across OSes), cross-platform input corroboration

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events
